testcase: A single partial index covering every IN-list value needs no UnionScan

explain.statement: SELECT true AS present FROM $explan AS p WHERE ANY v WITHIN p.plan.`~children` SATISFIES v.`#operator` LIKE 'IndexScan%' AND v.`index` = 'ix_pu_eu' END AND NOT (ANY v WITHIN p.plan.`~children` SATISFIES v.`#operator` = 'UnionScan' END)

statements: SELECT pu_city, pu_country FROM shellTest WHERE pu_city LIKE "A%" AND pu_country IN ["Germany", "Spain"] ORDER BY pu_country, pu_city
